brief:
Israeli military attacks killed nine Palestinians and injured eighteen others across a 48-hour period, according to the Palestinian health ministry. Rescue workers also recovered one additional body from the rubble of previous Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip, the ministry said.

The Palestinian health ministry did not immediately provide specifics about where the strikes occurred, when they took place, or the circumstances surrounding each attack. The toll represents a continuation of Israeli military operations in the enclave, Middle East Eye reported.
